@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'Extras: Doctorable protocol, HealthCheck, DoctorRunner and DoctorReport'
+---
+## What
+
+Upstream work in `../FoundationModelsExtras`, not in this repository. It
+unblocks the `doctor` subcommand of cli-plan.md §5.12. The full
+specification is `FoundationModelsExtras/doctor-plan.md`, milestones D1
+and D2.
+
+Add a new module to `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Doctor/`:
+
+- `HealthStatus`: `ok`, `warning`, `error`. `Sendable`, `Codable`.
+- `HealthCheck`: `name`, `status`, `message`, `fix: String?`,
+  `category`. `Sendable`, `Equatable`, `Codable`. Static makers `ok`,
+  `warning`, `error`, where `warning` and `error` require a `fix`.
+- `Doctorable` protocol: `doctorName`, `doctorCategory`, `isApplicable`
+  (default `true`), `func runHealthChecks() async -> [HealthCheck]`
+  (default: one `.ok` check built from the name and the category).
+- `DoctorReport`: holds `checks`, computes `worstStatus` and
+  `exitCode` — 0 for all `.ok`, 1 for any `.error`, 5 for warnings with
+  no error.
+- `DoctorRunner`: `init(components: [any Doctorable])` and
+  `run() async -> DoctorReport`. It runs the components concurrently in
+  a task group, it skips the components where `isApplicable` is false,
+  and it keeps the registration order in the result.
+
+`runHealthChecks()` never throws. A check that cannot run reports
+`.error` with the reason in its message, so one broken check cannot stop
+the others.
+
+This module declares no terminal dependency. Extras is a library that
+also runs inside a Mac app.
+
+- [ ] `HealthStatus` and `HealthCheck`
+- [ ] `Doctorable`, with the two default implementations
+- [ ] `DoctorReport` and its exit code
+- [ ] `DoctorRunner`, concurrent and order-stable
+- [ ] Merge to `main` in the Extras repository
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A type that declares only `doctorName` and `doctorCategory`
+      compiles, and it gives one `.ok` check.
+- [ ] `DoctorReport.exitCode` gives 0, 1 and 5 for the three cases.
+- [ ] `DoctorRunner` runs the components concurrently: a run of N
+      components that each wait 100 ms finishes in well under N × 100 ms.
+- [ ] The report order matches the registration order, whatever the
+      finish order.
+- [ ] No file in the module imports a terminal or a color library.
+- [ ] The change is on Extras `main`, because this package tracks the
+      `main` branch.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/Doctor/DoctorableTests.swift`:
+      the default implementation gives exactly one `.ok` check, named
+      and categorized from the protocol properties.
+- [ ] `isApplicable == false` contributes no checks, and the component
+      stays in the runner's list.
+- [ ] `DoctorReportTests`: the exit code of each of the three cases.
+- [ ] `DoctorRunnerTests`: concurrency (the timing assertion above) and
+      a stable order.
+- [ ] `HealthCheck` round-trips through `JSONEncoder` and
+      `JSONDecoder`.
+- [ ] `swift test` in `../FoundationModelsExtras` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
